values.description: Ahmedabad has historic Hindu, Islamic and Jain monuments and traditional neighbourhoods known as pols. Its visitor sites include Gandhi Ashram and museums.

records.notes: City has no single admission fee, duration or rating; these remain nullable rather than aggregating unrelated attractions.

values.description: Gandhi's former ashram on the Sabarmati river contains a memorial museum and preserved buildings associated with his life.
values.best_time_note: Open daily, including public holidays. Hridaykunj interior is temporarily closed for conservation; view from outside.

values.description: Adalaj's five-storey stepwell was commissioned by Queen Rudabai in 1499. Carved pillars and walls surround the descent to the well.

records.notes: The attraction is in Gandhinagar district and remains an Ahmedabad excursion. No wheelchair boolean inferred from steps or photographs.

values.description: Sidi Saiyyed Mosque near Khanpur Gate is known for carved stone screens. The existing record also groups the old-city pol neighbourhoods with this mosque.

records.notes: Grouped original entity preserved; one coordinate is a mosque anchor, not the extent of all pols.

values.description: The Sarabhai Foundation's Calico Museum displays textiles and collections of Indian art in Ahmedabad's Shahibaug area.
values.best_time_note: Haveli guided tour 10:30â€“12:30, entry 10:15â€“10:30. Pre-registration required; closed Mondays and public holidays. Separate Chauk tour 14:30â€“16:30.

records.notes: Stored interval models the morning tour only. Current schema cannot enforce weekday closures, reservations, or fixed-start admission. Do not claim arbitrary arrival within the interval guarantees entry.

values.description: Sarkhej Roza is a mosque, tomb and palace complex associated with the Sufi saint Ahmed Khattu Ganj Baksh. Historic buildings surround a large tank.

records.notes: Accessibility remains unverified.

values.description: Kankaria is a historic Ahmedabad lake surrounding the island garden of Nagina Wadi. The lakefront has recreation facilities, with a zoo and aquarium nearby.

records.notes: Individual activities have separate tickets; retained lake admission is not an all-attractions pass.

values.description: French Haveli is a restored Gujarati heritage home in Ahmedabad's old-city pol neighbourhoods. Rooms occupy several floors; the property has no car parking and the final 100 metres are reached on foot or by rickshaw.

records.notes: Existing price/rating retained as historical project-approved values, not freshly verified by this website. Amenities described only where operator confirms them.
